content: {"paper_id":"W2292124520","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"Spatio-temporal tensor completion for imputing missing internet traffic data","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确以补全缺失的互联网流量数据为目标；摘要亦称恢复张量中的缺失项，输出为待恢复数据，符合数据补全与恢复。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"This approach not only takes advantage of tensor decomposition and its lower-dimensional representation","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确利用张量分解及其低维表示来建模流量数据，属于显式利用张量分解/低维结构表示相关结构，符合低秩建模。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"traffic-data","reason_zh":"论文处理互联网/网络OD流量矩阵，虽含traffic data字样，但定义限定道路交通速度、流量、轨迹等实际对象；无法确定通信网络流量是否覆盖，故弃权。"}],"input_issues":[]}
